name: Asahikawa (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with a white five-pointed star charged with a red disc.
history: The flag of Asahikawa bears the city's mon (municipal emblem) in the Japanese civic tradition of a single stylised mark on a plain field.

features.role: Asahikawa municipal emblem — a white five-pointed star charged with a red disc
features.symbolism: the North Star over Japan's northern inland city
